dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: What time do you usually wake up?
dialogue.translation: A que horas você costuma acordar?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: Around seven. I get out of bed, open the curtains and make my bed
dialogue.translation: Por volta das sete. Eu levanto, abro as cortinas e arrumo a cama

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: Do you check your phone straight away?
dialogue.translation: Você olha o celular logo de cara?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: No, I don’t. I brush my teeth and have breakfast first
dialogue.translation: Não. Primeiro eu escovo os dentes e tomo café da manhã

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.text: What do you usually have for breakfast?
dialogue.translation: O que você costuma comer no café da manhã?

dialogue.speaker: Ana
dialogue.text: Eggs and toast, with a cup of coffee. Then I plan my content
dialogue.translation: Ovos e torradas, com uma xícara de café. Depois eu planejo meu conteúdo

grammar.title: Build simple present routines
grammar.instruction: Use simple present for habits, with do or does for questions and negatives

rows.subject: Affirmative
rows.verb: I / you / we / they + base; he / she / it + verb-s
rows.example: I work out in the afternoon. She works out in the afternoon

rows.subject: Negative
rows.example: I don’t check my phone at breakfast. She doesn’t check hers

rows.subject: Question
rows.example: Do you exercise in the morning? Does she exercise in the morning?

grammar.note: After does/doesn’t, use the base verb. Frequency adverbs usually go before the main verb: I usually work out; she often goes to the gym.

listening.title: Listen and answer
listening.instruction: Listen to your best friend Kim and find out what her routine is like
listening.greeting: I finally have a quiet moment before bed 🌙
listening.text: On most days, I wake up around seven and have coffee and toast. I plan my content before I start filming. Before the gym, I choose a comfortable outfit, tie my hair up and pack a towel and a water bottle. I go three times a week, usually in the afternoon. I warm up, lift weights and stretch at the end. I don’t post every clip I film. I save some for another day. After dinner, I reply to messages and do my skincare. I wash my face and put on moisturizer. Before bed, I leave my phone on my desk because I sleep better that way. What about you? What helps you relax at night?
